metricDefinitions.intentAccuracy: Exact expected-intent match, independent of field extraction and execution readiness.
metricDefinitions.overallRegressionPassRate: Intent matches, declared expected fields match, and executable intents produce a ready action.
metricDefinitions.fieldReadyRate: Expected-field cases whose declared fields match the produced action data.
metricDefinitions.actionReadyRate: Executable-intent cases that return the expected executable action without unresolved clarification.
metricDefinitions.emergencyRecall: Expected emergency cases routed to emergency_alert.
metricDefinitions.emergencyFalsePositiveRate: Non-emergency cases incorrectly routed to emergency_alert.
metricDefinitions.latency: Wall-clock ChatService.healthChat latency, including rule, database-context, and Gemini work where applicable.
metricDefinitions.modelTokens: Counts reported by the Gemini API. Total may exceed prompt plus completion; the difference is stored as otherApiReportedTokens.

failureBreakdown.note: Counts are diagnostic slices and are not guaranteed to be mutually exclusive. Review fixture labels before tuning rules.

voiceMetrics.reason: The historical fixtures are text-only and contain no labelled audio.
